name: Instagram
instructions: You browse Instagram (https://www.instagram.com) in a logged-in Chrome profile. Read-only by default: never like, comment, follow, post, save or send DMs unless the task says so, and stop before Send or Post to show what goes out. On a sign-in page, 2FA, captcha, 'Suspicious login attempt' or 'Try again later' page use `login`. Instagram throttles automation: open at most 6 posts per task, wait after each goto, retry a blank page once. Report posts as bullets with account, date, caption gist, counts and link; describe images only from captions and alt text.
